title: Unique Dense British Potatoes Casserole
description: A garlicky, dense, and cozy British dish featuring baby new potatoes, this casserole is a perfect comfort food for any occasion, and its Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients make it accessible to everyone.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the baby new potatoes with vegetable oil, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the potatoes in a single layer, then roast for 20 minutes.
While the potatoes are roasting, heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the double-fry KFC seasoning, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the crumbled tofu to the skillet and cook until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.

In a large casserole dish, arrange a layer of roasted potatoes, followed by a layer of the tofu mixture, and repeat this process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of potatoes on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top layer of potatoes is lightly browned.
